verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for a billing platform, since some products in this category ship self-hostable deployments, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted, on-prem, or open-source deployment of Orb. The pack describes only Orb's hosted UI, API, SDKs, and managed exports, and the 'production deployments' throughput claim does not describe customer self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
